_meta.why: polaris-report-2026.09.10 dynamic-mapped min_record_time as TEXT: the Lua wrote "" on idle windows and a fresh daily index almost always opens on one at 30s windows. Dynamic mapping types a field from the FIRST document it sees and keeps it for the life of that index, so no range query or date histogram works there again. A template survives an idle first window; waiting for a fresh index does not. Measured by the API matrix run 1789026666, and predicted before it in SCHEMA-report.md review #2.
_meta.pairs_with: the Lua now OMITS min/max_record_time when nil (fluent-bit/values.yaml). BOTH OR NEITHER: with these fields typed as date, a document carrying "" is rejected per-item inside a bulk that still returns HTTP 200.
_meta.not_retroactive: applies only to indices CREATED after it is applied. polaris-report-2026.09.10 and earlier stay text for their life.
